FAQ

Common questions

What happens after my site or system goes live?

You get 2 months of free maintenance after launch. I monitor it, fix anything I built that has a problem, and make small updates at no cost to you.

What happens after the 2 months?

The 2-month free maintenance period covers fixes to anything I built and small updates. After that, ongoing maintenance is optional and agreed with you separately. New features, redesigns and new pages are scoped separately.

Can I see it before it goes live?

Yes. I build it and send a preview link. You review the finished version and request the included round of revisions before it goes live.

Do I need my own domain?

No. I can launch your site on a subdomain, or connect your own custom domain if you have already bought one.

Privacy Policy

When you send the contact form or the quick-question chat, I collect the details you type in, such as your name, email address and message. I use them only to reply to you and to keep a record of your inquiry.

Inquiries are saved in a private spreadsheet and sent to my email. I do not sell your details or share them with anyone else. This page also remembers your light or dark mode choice in your browser.
